title: Subquery returning a non-null value in WHERE clause incorrectly evaluates to FALSE and returns zero rows
bug_query: SELECT * FROM t0 WHERE ((SELECT DISTINCT t0.c0 FROM t0));
expected: All rows of t0 are returned because the scalar subquery is non-null.
actual: 0 rows returned; the subquery is ambiguous and yields NULL (NOT A BUG).

title: Vuln85-66: decimal decimalNewFromText Unbounded Whitespace-skip Over-read
expected: The all-whitespace sort key is compared without reading past the key buffer.
actual: ASAN heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 in decimalNewFromText.

title: lifelineVuln1: Repeated cksumvfs initialization makes the global VFS self-referential and causes infinite recursion
expected: Registering the cksumvfs extension twice is harmless.
actual: The wrapper VFS points at itself; the next database open recurses into a stack-overflow crash.

title: Vuln6: Integer Overflow and Double Free in ICU Extension icuCaseFunc16
expected: upper() on a very long U+0390 string either succeeds or reports SQLITE_TOOBIG.
actual: nOut = 2*u_strToUpper() wraps negative; ASAN SEGV (double free) in icuCaseFunc16.

title: Vuln44-15: Vector IN Step-6 Ignores aiMap Permutation When the Engine Uses an Index With Reordered Columns
expected: 0 (and NOT IN returns 1), as without the index.
actual: NULL (and NOT IN also returns NULL) once the index on (b,a) exists.

title: SQLite: empty INTERSECT and EXCEPT branches are not folded to an empty result
bug_query: SELECT v FROM a INTERSECT SELECT v FROM b WHERE 0;
expected: The provably empty branch folds the whole compound to an empty result with no scan.
actual: Both branches are scanned into temp b-trees; 230.733 ms versus 0.004 ms.

title: Vuln27-8: Transitive Optimization Discards Explicit COLLATE During pLeft Substitution, Dropping Valid Rows
bug_query: SELECT t1.a, t2.b FROM t1 CROSS JOIN t2 WHERE t1.a = t2.b AND t2.b COLLATE NOCASE = 'Hello';
expected: 4 rows (all case variants), as with SQLITE_Transitive disabled.
actual: 1 row (only the exact-case 'Hello'); the derived term loses the explicit COLLATE.

title: rtree_i32 applies the x0<=x1 constraint after narrowing to 32 bits, so a well-ordered box is rejected
bug_query: SELECT group_concat(id) FROM rt WHERE x0 <= 1 AND x1 >= -1;
expected: The row inserted at 4294967296 is not returned for the region [-1,1].
actual: Returns 1; the coordinate wrapped to 0, and INSERT(1, 2147483647, 2147483648) is wrongly rejected.

title: SQLite: redundant ORDER BY inside EXISTS prevents a covering-index lookup
bug_query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t AS a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t AS b WHERE b.x = a.x ORDER BY b.y);
expected: SEARCH b USING COVERING INDEX idx_t_x (x=?), same as without the inner ORDER BY.
actual: SEARCH b USING INDEX idx_t_x (x=?); 1.18x slower (72.425 ms versus 61.364 ms).

title: printf()/format() reads the '*' width and precision modulo 2^32, silently shortening the result
expected: 'abcdef' - a precision far larger than the string yields the whole string.
actual: '' (empty); the precision is read modulo 2^32 (developer: unspecified, documentation updated).

title: CHECK(changes()=0) constraint can be bypassed and insert rows that should have been rejected
expected: Both INSERT ... SELECT forms behave the same under the CHECK constraint.
actual: The plain form inserts 42; the ORDER BY form fails with 'CHECK constraint failed' (NOT A BUG).

title: Invalid complementary filtering result for rtree virtual table left join query
bug_query: SELECT rt0.c4, rt0.c3, rt0.c1, rt0.c2, rt0.c0 FROM t1 LEFT OUTER JOIN rt0 ON (SELECT DISTINCT t1.c0 FROM t1 NOT INDEXED) WHERE ((NOT (rt0.c2)));
expected: WHERE (rt0.c2) and WHERE (NOT rt0.c2) are mutually exclusive and cover the 16 base-join rows.
actual: 8 rows and 0 rows; the ON subquery is ambiguous (NOT A BUG).

title: Vuln26-7: Vector IN Step-6 Collation Mismatch Returns FALSE Instead of NULL and Bypasses Blacklist Filters
bug_query: SELECT ('hello', NULL) IN (SELECT a, b FROM t1);
expected: NULL - 'hello' matches 'Hello' under NOCASE and a NULL element makes it unknown.
actual: 0 (and NOT ... IN returns 1); step 6 re-scans with BINARY.

title: sqlite3ExprAffinity() Fails to Traverse TK_UPLUS, Causing Wrong Query Results
expected: 0, the same as 'a > 123', because unary + is documented as a no-op.
actual: 1; +a has no affinity so the comparison runs without TEXT coercion (NOT A BUG / WONT_FIX).

title: Vuln96-77: json_each/json_tree Heap Over-read via JSONB Object with Dangling Trailing Label
expected: The malformed JSONB object is rejected or read within the blob.
actual: ASAN heap-buffer-overflow READ of size 1 in jsonEachColumn (json.c:5401).

title: SELECT DISTINCT ORDER BY returns different row order depending on index usage
bug_query: SELECT DISTINCT c0, typeof(c0) FROM t0 ORDER BY c0;
expected: The same row order as the NOT INDEXED plan (real 1523828428.0 first).
actual: Index scan returns the integer 1523828428 first; the values are equal so either order is allowed (NOT A BUG).

title: SQLite3 Non-deterministic Function Bypass in CREATE INDEX Expression Validation
expected: CREATE INDEX rejected with 'non-deterministic functions prohibited in index expressions'.
actual: CREATE INDEX succeeds; reporter later retracted - UNLIKELY is deterministic (WONT_FIX).

title: Unexpected Results When Comparing Rowid with a Large Floating-Point Value
bug_query: SELECT rowid FROM t WHERE rowid = 9223372036854775807.0;
expected: No rows, since 'rowid = 9223372036854775807.0' evaluates to 0.
actual: One row, 9223372036854775807; IEEE754 rounding makes both answers defensible (NOT A BUG).

title: Vuln91-72: amatch 16-bit Truncation of amatch_word.nMatch Causes Negative-index Heap Over-read
expected: A MATCH string longer than 32768 bytes is matched without reading outside zInput.
actual: nMatch wraps to -32768; ASAN read of size 1 far before zInput in amatchNext (amatch.c:1235).

title: SQLite `quote()`/`sqlite3QuoteValue()` Embedded NUL Text Data Loss
bug_query: SELECT quote(data), length(quote(data)) FROM t WHERE id=1;
expected: The whole 23-byte TEXT value is quoted (round-trips through .dump).
actual: 'role=user' only, 9 bytes - %Q stops at the embedded NUL (NOT PLANNED, feature request).
